The ToolSearch step is done (the pull_request_read schema came back). Posting a review on PR #1162 is outward-facing, and the two earlier runs today already returned the same unpinned-shellcheck finding, so a post would likely duplicate it. Should I run the posting review?

options.label: Run it, posting allowed (Recommended)
options.description: Invoke /rvw-pr 1162 with posting, then send the three answers (a/b/c) back to the requesting session. A review with the shellcheck-pin finding lands on PR #1162.

options.label: Run it analyze-only
options.description: Run the review without posting. The diagnostic still gets answers (a) and (c), but (b) reflects a non-posting run, so it may not test the posting path BK-459 is after.

options.label: Decline
options.description: Run nothing more. I only reply to the session with answer (a) and say that you declined the posting run.
